questions.prompt: Hari abagabo muri iza nka. Nanjye ndashaka kuzibamo.
questions.answer: There are men among these cows. I also want to be among them.

questions.prompt: Kubiteka no kubibika ubu ni byo byiza. Biri he? Simbibona.
questions.answer: It's best to cook them and put them away now. Where are they? I don't see them.

questions.prompt: Simbibona rwose, ntabwo biri hano. Oya, ntibiri hariya, bari hano. Ngwino ubirebe.
questions.answer: I don't see them at all; they are surely not here. No they are not there; they are here. Come and see them.

questions.prompt: Mbese uri Petero? Oya, sindi we rwose!
questions.answer: Are you Peter? No I certainly am not him!

questions.prompt: Zana intebe. Zana n'ikirago. Mbese biri mu nzu? Yego, nzi ko birimo.
questions.answer: Bring a chair (or chairs) . Bring a rug also. Are they inside the house? Yes, I know they are inside.

questions.prompt: Abantu bakuru barabakunda. Na twe turabakunda. Tuzi ko muri abana beza.
questions.answer: The adults love you (plural). We also love you. We know that you are good children.

questions.prompt: Mbese, har'abana mu murima? Oya, ntabwo bawurimo. Ndagira ngo bari mu nzu.
questions.answer: Are there children in the garden? No, they are not in it. I suppose they are inside (the house).

questions.prompt: Ndagira ngo umuhanda ni mugari, kandi si mugufi.
questions.answer: I suppose the road is wide, and it is not short.

questions.prompt: Niba ukomeza kwiba ntabwo uzabona umunezero. Gukora neza ni byo bizana amahoro.
questions.answer: If you continue to steal, you will never never find happiness. Doing well is what brings peace.

questions.prompt: Mbese urashaka iki? Ntabwo uzabona umugore ejo; ntabwo uzamubona n'ejo bundi.
questions.answer: What do you want? You will definitely not find a wife tomorrow; and you will certainly not find one the day after tomorrow.

questions.prompt: Mbese uragira ngo ndi nde? Nawe uri nde? (Namwe muri bande?)
questions.answer: Who do you suppose I am? And who are you? (In the singular and plural)
